title: Counting Bits Sequence
statement: Given a non-negative integer n, return a list ans of length n + 1 where ans[i] is the number of 1 bits in the binary representation of i, for every i from 0 to n. Your solution should run in O(n) total time (avoid calling a population-count routine independently for every value).
hints: Counting bits for every number independently is O(n log n); look for a way to reuse previously computed answers.
Notice that i >> 1 drops the last bit of i, and (i & 1) tells you whether that dropped bit was a 1.
Build the answer array bottom-up with ans[i] = ans[i >> 1] + (i & 1), starting from ans[0] = 0.
